title: Dot Mutation Protocol
author: 宏亮 董
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7iehkbe

steps.title: Amplify plasmid by reverse PCR
steps.instruction: Perform reverse PCR of the entire plasmid using primers that contain the fragment sequence you want to replace.

steps.title: Digest template plasmid with DpnI
steps.instruction: Add DpnI enzyme to the PCR mixture to digest the methylated template plasmid.

steps.title: Transform into DH5α and incubate
steps.instruction: Transform the DpnI‑digested product into competent DH5α cells, plate the transformants, and incubate overnight at 37 °C.

steps.title: Screen colonies by PCR and digestion
steps.instruction: Perform colony PCR and restriction enzyme digestion on the overnight cultures to verify successful vector construction.

steps.title: Sequence positive clones
steps.instruction: Select colonies that gave positive PCR/digestion results, submit them for DNA sequencing, and obtain the final confirmed constructs.
